#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
Lady Annalie: Thanks, {f_botName}. At least you care about me.
You: …
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
Lady Annalie: Please take my hand and let’s skate away from this guy.
#bot.Expression.sad
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Bot: I-If that’s what you want…
You: Wha?!
I can’t believe I was betrayed that easily…
You: Are you two really going to just skate away?! Wait for me!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: You are doing great, Annalie! So please, cheer up a little.
#Annalie_Outside.face.smileEyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Even if you say that…{{wi}} I can’t stop shaking my legs. My knees seem to instinctively try to find balance.
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Bot: Soon you should get used to it. {{wi}}I think…
#Annalie_Outside.face.sad
Lady Annalie: You could have left the last part to yourself, you know?
Bot: Maybe I should’ve, but I didn’t want to lie to you.
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Thanks I guess…
Lady Annalie: Damn, you are much better at this than me.
